# ReferencePointPicker

**Class:** `UltraCanvasReferencePointPicker` · **Group:** [Buttons and choices](../Groups/Buttons-and-choices.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasReferencePointPicker.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasReferencePointPicker.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasReferencePointPicker.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Which point of a box stays put - a 3 x 3 grid of corners, edge midpoints and centre, for a transform bar's scale / rotate / move ([doc](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasReferencePointPicker.md))

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasReferencePointPicker](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasReferencePointPicker.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasReferencePointPicker> CreateReferencePointPicker( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h, ReferencePoint point = ReferencePoint::Centre);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasReferencePointPicker(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasReferencePointPicker(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h);
explicit UltraCanvasReferencePointPicker(const std::string& identifier);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).
